question: A single discount equivalent to successive discounts of 40% and 20% is:
solution:
**Given:**

A single discount equivalent to successive discounts of 40% and 20%

**Formula used:**

Single Discount = 1 - (1 - d₁) × (1 - d₂)

**Calculation:**

Single Discount = 1 - (1 - 0.40) × (1 - 0.20)

⇒ Single Discount = 1 - 0.60 × 0.80

⇒ Single Discount = 1 - 0.48

⇒ Single Discount = 0.52 = **52%**

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 

Single discount = D₁ + D₂ - (D₁ × D₂)/100

⇒ 40 + 20 - 40 × 20 /100 = 60 - 8 = 52%
